### Daemon Server (`/packages/codesurf-daemon/src/server.ts`)

Handles: session management (create/resume, FIFO guard), turn execution (NodeSessionHost), SSE streaming (live tool calls + token events), REST endpoints, MCP server bridge, configurable auth token.

**Robustness verdict:** Sound for local/dev use; not hardened for multi-user or high-availability.

Known gaps:
1. No request queuing / backpressure beyond session-level FIFO
2. No automatic restart on crash
3. Health-check and retry logic absent from client

- Plugin preferences isolated per-process (fix: stop processes overwriting each other)
